All insured persons declare that they have no other insurance of a similar kind covering the insured premises and have never been declined insurance, had a renewal refused, been required to pay an additional premium or had special terms and conditions imposed for any home insurance policy.
All insured persons confirm that the total value of valuable property contained within the insured premises does not exceed one-third of the Sum Insured of Section 1 – Household Contents.

All insured persons confirm that they are the legal owner or the tenant of the insured premises on or before the policy effective date, and that the insured premises is their family’s and their principal place of residence.
All insured persons confirm that they have not made a claim under any home insurance policy in the preceding two years.

All insured persons shall comply with all statutory obligations and take reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage; and to maintain the insured property in good condition and that any repairs carried out are of sound quality.

All insured persons shall comply with relevant fire safety rules and regulations, and fulfill the requirements set out in the deed of mutual covenant related to open kitchen construction within the insured premises.

All insured persons authorise the proposer to complete the application on their behalf and declare that all information given in the application is true and correct to the best of their knowledge.
